title: MarkdownConversation
description: Lean projection of a claude.ai conversation, isomorphic to its markdown rendering: just the title, URL, and an ordered list of role-tagged text turns. Projected (by stripping metadata) from the richer apiConversation capture, and renderable straight to markdown without any browser/DOM scraping. The same shape is the projection target for bulk-export conversations. See model_join.csv for the field correspondence.
